charts.title: TOI-1238 c: orbits around TOI-1238
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1238's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1238 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag512L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 3.2947609691 d

charts.title: TOI-1238 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1238 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (49, 74, 76) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 153951307, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
